_about: Frame-by-frame timing of the Contra (NES, US) Any% No Turbo 1P record: Angrylanks 9:48.183, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgtFCclM1jM (speedrun.com run z0nxpj9m). Measured 2026-10-11 from the 720p60 stream in the built-in browser (canvas reads at exact seeks). All 'f' values are VIDEO frame indices: frame n covers video time [n/60, (n+1)/60) s. 'cum_f' = f - 720 (START). 'cum_s' = cum_f / 60. See record_notes.md for method and caveats.

video.container_fps_evidence: Frame boundaries found by 1 ms seeks sit at n/60 s with the same phase at t=30, 200, 400 and 690 s (30.017/30.034/30.050 ... 690.017/690.034/690.050). A 59.94 stream would drift by 0.69 s over that span. Constant frame rate, exactly 60.000.
video.content_rate: About 30 distinct images per second. The capture treats the NES 240p signal as 480i: each captured image is two consecutive NES frames woven line by line, and each captured image is shown for 2 video frames. Pairing is not perfectly regular: occasional single video frames and occasional 4-frame holds (capture jitter).

game_area_px.note: left 288 px is handcam (top) and LiveSplit (bottom)

tolerance.half_field_events: +/-1 video frame. When an event is first seen combed (in one field only) the new state is in the later of the two woven NES frames. START and END are both of this kind.
tolerance.approximate_events: marked with tol_f in each entry

start.rule: Timer starts when the blue life medals appear.
start.detail: 719 has no medals (medal box blue mean 0.9). 720-721 show the two medals in one field only (combed, blue mean 18.4). 722 onward both fields (37.1).

anchors.title_note: The '1 PLAYER' line is already flashing from the first title frame (144); flash period about 16 video frames.
anchors.bill_first_visible_note: Somersaulting near the top of the screen, same captured image in which the medals become full. Drifting right from about 724. First frame he CAN move is not observable from video.

end.rule: Timer ends when Bill automatically reverts to the standing pose after the heart dies (hold Up or Down).
end.detail: Bill is prone (Down held) through 36010. 36011-36012 are one woven image: prone in one field, standing in the other. 36013 onward fully standing.
end.heart_first_explosion_note: First explosion sprite on the heart at 35788 (pair 35788-35789). Bill was mid-jump beside the heart and lands on this frame. Treat as last hit +/-2.
end.runner_holds: Down. In-game Bill is prone from shortly after the kill until the automatic stand. Handcam shows one hand still on the controller; the button itself cannot be read at that resolution.

span.note: The moderators' number is exactly (first video frame with medals) to (first video frame with any standing pose) counted at 60 fps.

calibration_intervals_video_frames.note: Fixed in-game delays as seen in this video. A RAM harness can measure the same delays in NES frames; they should come out about 0.16% larger (60.0988/60).

fire_rate.method: Space-time diagram of bullet positions along the firing line; interval between successive centre-line spread bullets = spacing / bullet speed.

sample_1.where: Snow Field, standing still firing straight up before the boss, frames 23248-23312

sample_2.where: Energy Zone, firing right just before the boss lands, frames 27464-27486

fire_rate.handcam: Spectra of the hand region during the stage 1 boss and the heart show weak peaks at 11.5-13.5 Hz; supportive only.
fire_rate.recommended_ai_cap: 12 presses per second (at least 5 frames between press starts)
fire_rate.caveat: Counts only presses that spawned a bullet. With spread the on-screen bullet limit can swallow presses, so his true press rate may be higher. Shortest single gaps were 4.0 frames.
